evidence.text:
Reason for referral: Evaluation of a recent fainting episode with brief loss of
consciousness.

Findings: Normal sinus rhythm at 86 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 188 ms, QRS 104 ms, QTc
414 ms.
Impression: Normal sinus rhythm with voltage criteria for left ventricular hypertrophy.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricularejection fraction estimated at
60%. Grade 1 diastolic dysfunction. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Normal left ventricular systolic function.

LIPID PANEL
Total Cholesterol: 258 mg/dL (H)
LDL Cholesterol: 180 mg/dL (H)
HDL Cholesterol: 33 mg/dL (L)
Triglycerides: 226 mg/dL (H)

BASIC METABOLIC PANEL
Sodium: 137 mmol/L
Potassium: 4.7 mmol/L
Chloride: 106 mmol/L
CO2: 23 mmol/L
BUN: 19 mg/dL
Creatinine: 0.7 mg/dL
Glucose: 178 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 9.1 mg/dL

Lisinopril 10 mg by mouth once daily
Levothyroxine 50 mcg by mouth once daily

EXM:
General: well appearing, no distress.
Neck: no carotid bruits.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, grade 2/6 systolic ejection
murmur, no radiation.
Lungs: clear bilaterally.
Extremities: 1+ pitting edema of both ankles.
